definitions.explanation: Having no sense of shame; bold and unapologetic in inappropriate behavior. A literary term for shamelessness, often used in the compound {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち}.

examples.japanese: {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち}な{態度|たいど}
{彼|かれ}は{厚顔|こうがん}にも{嘘|うそ}をつき{通|とお}した。
あれだけの{不祥事|ふしょうじ}を{起|お}こしておいて、{厚顔|こうがん}にも{再出馬|さいしゅつば}するとは。
examples.english: After causing such a scandal, he has the audacity to run for office again.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective (also functions as noun). Uses な before nouns: {厚顔|こうがん}な{人|ひと}.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {厚顔|こうがん}にも (brazenly, shamelessly)

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち} (brazen and shameless) is a common set phrase combining two synonyms for emphasis.

NUANCE: {厚顔|こうがん} is more literary and formal than {厚|あつ}かましい or {図々|ずうずう}しい. It's often used in formal writing, news reports, or when criticizing public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち} (brazen and shameless)
- {厚顔|こうがん}にも (brazenly, shamelessly)
- {厚顔|こうがん}な{態度|たいど} (brazen attitude)

RELATED WORDS:
- {厚|あつ}かましい (impudent, shameless - more colloquial)
- {図々|ずうずう}しい (shameless, impudent)
- {恥知|はじし}らず (shameless person)
- {鉄面皮|てつめんぴ} (brazen-faced - literary)
